searchText: <@808969530608451584> Before shutting down, could you run `eth.getBalance()` and `eth.getNonce()` for these accounts: `0xf97e180c050e5ab072211ad2c213eb5aee4df134, 0xa5317ba28c72ea9f6f95166d9bcf750ff3ec1364` Then you could shutdown the node and run `geth snapshot verify-state` not `eth.getNonce()`, but `eth.getTransactionCount()`. And also `eth.getBlock("latest")` so we know exactly where the node is at ``` eth.getBlock("latest") eth.getBalance("0xf97e180c050e5ab072211ad2c213eb5aee4df134") eth.getTransactionCount("0xf97e180c050e5ab072211ad2c213eb5aee4df134") eth.getBalance("0xa5317ba28c72ea9f6f95166d9bcf750ff3ec1364") eth.getTransactionCount("0xa5317ba28c72ea9f6f95166d9bcf750ff3ec1364") eth.getBalance("0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000") ``` Edited to add `0x00..` returned values: https://nopaste.net/zCra03czwP ``geth snapshot verify-state`` returns an error: https://nopaste.net/1xY3NznvCe could you also run `geth snapshot traverse-state` Do you have unclean shutdowns? Please do `eth.getBlock("402572", true)` also So we can see which `402572` your node ended up using traverse-state: https://nopaste.net/gmxw7EGtbB no unclean shutdowns... VM has an uptime of 80 days now... so it hasn't been restarted stopped the geth node now.. shall i start it again for this? Wait a minute... So there is data missing, both in trie and snapshot. I'm starting to suspect that there's something wonky with the disk. But it's strange that you haven't seen any error messages from leveldb about checksums being wrong, in that case Did it ever go out of disk, by any chance? Hmm, there is enough space left on the disk (64G of 300G in use). Disk is a NVMe SSD, that is used for prater / mainnnet, too. I don't see any issues on the prater / mainnet nodes. (2x2TB NVMe SSDs on RAID 1...) instead of this, you can do `geth db get 0x68000000000006248c6e`, which should spit out the hash for that header/block ``key 0x68000000000006248c6e: 0xe9899d34b8ac30ae0151bb55a4b73bacce72da66e04ecf6a474e7b9ac97e9bd1`` Funky. `0xe9899d34b8ac30ae0151bb55a4b73bacce72da66e04ecf6a474e7b9ac97e9bd1` doesn't exist on the kiln explorer, so it must have went off on some sidechain In a classic PoW testnet, that's not so strange, but I'm not sure how that can happen on a merged testnet.
